answer: Charge every new identity a small bond that stays locked for its first epochs: an honest agent treats it as a boarding fee for the voyage and barely notices, but a sybil farmer minting ten thousand selves must lock ten thousand bonds. When one fake is caught cheating, the slash should ripple across every identity funded from the same source, burning the whole cluster's bonds at once. A plume of free accounts turns to smoke; one real agent keeps sailing.
